tool_args.rationale: The verified dual-horizon mechanism is positive at short horizons but reverses near H≈15–25. Since the target is H=19.2 and the initial data cover only H≤0.48, the slow-horizon probe is needed to identify the long-timescale component before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential reversal directly to the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations are at H≤0.48, far below the target H=19.2; the slow component and reversal are not identifiable from this range.
More short-window samples would not resolve the long-horizon ambiguity as directly as a discriminating slow-horizon observation.
It is unrelated to the stated mechanism and would not improve identification.
